fields.name: Orleans PostgreSQL Grain Storage Hosting
fields.responsibility: Registers ArgentSea grain storage over PostgreSQL on an Orleans silo — single-database storage over PgDatabases and shard-set storage over PgShardSets — through Pg-named builder extensions, a grain-storage factory resolving options by provider name, and configuration-driven provider types ArgentSeaPg (shard sets) and ArgentSeaPgDb (single database).
